# SEO-476: Report contributed posts republished at several addresses

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

A submission reachable through more than one address, whether by cross-posting into multiple sections or by a per-tag route, is reported so the site can decide which address is the one to index.

## Rationale

Every extra address for the same post competes with the others, and a site that generates them automatically multiplies its own content without adding anything a reader wants.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site",
    "ugc"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Enumerate the addresses each post is reachable through and compare them against the canonical value the post declares, reporting posts whose reachable set exceeds one canonical address.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Crawl contributed sections, group responses by post identifier, and report identifiers reachable at more than one address that do not agree on a canonical value.
- Evidence: `ROUTE`, `RENDERED_HTML`, `REDIRECT_CHAIN`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: That one post reachable at several addresses needs one nominated address is a consistency property of the site's own routing and needs no external citation. Which address to nominate depends on how the section is navigated, so the choice is reported rather than made.
